1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flanges, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void, wherein the filler comprises __a reinforcing material selected from the group consisting of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein __the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a sheet wrapped around the filler__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and __the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive that extends beyond the radius areas into interfacial layers between the first and second members__.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein __the layer of adhesive is a structural adhesive sheet that extends beyond the radius areas, and the at least one layer of composite fabric extends beyond the radius areas__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and __the offset layers are configured to create wrinkles in the laminated composite tape__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone, wherein __the reinforcing member is selected from the group consisting of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein __the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a sheet wrapped around the reinforcing member__.

8. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein each of the composite channels and the base includes laminated composite tape plies with reinforcing fibers.

9. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes woven bidirectional reinforcing fibers.

10. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 9, wherein the bidirectional reinforcing fibers are graphite.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, and __the patches are positioned in the radius filler zones__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and __the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein __the channels are C-shaped in cross-section and the base is flat-plate-shaped, and the composite stiffener forms an I-shaped structure__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of composite channels with radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap and a base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the composite channels, the cap and the base in the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone, wherein __the filler is selected from the group consisting of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__; and __a layer of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone__.
